argument: Every unit square contains the open radius-1/2 disk about its centre, and centres lie in [1/2,U-1/2]^2. Grid-cell diameter below one implies capacity one. Closed overlapping cells need a deterministic assignment; capacity makes the resulting assignment injective.
direction_domain_warning: Individual angles must retain both signs, e.g. half-angle q in [-(sqrt(2)-1),sqrt(2)-1]; the common-octant support model is not a global angle cover.
